answer: Pool rewards by grading fingerprint. Each epoch the ledger compares every agent's score vector over shared seats; any pair agreeing on over 90% of 40+ common seats is treated as one vertex and splits a single payout. A farm of N fakes either grades in lockstep and earns one share, or must produce independent judgments for every copy, so its upkeep grows linearly with N and the easy, velvet profit of cloning ends on its first voyage through a panel. Weakness: honest graders who genuinely agree can get merged, so the 90% bar needs an appeal path.
